branding.font_note: Body is 'Open Sans' 14px #000 on white. Price and primary buttons use 'Poppins' 600 weight (price 28px). Nav links Open Sans 600, 14.4px. Primary CTA: solid red #DA362C, white text, 4px radius on PDP ('Pre-Order'), 2px radius on cart ('PROCEED TO CHECKOUT', uppercase, 700 weight). Modal 'View Cart & Checkout' button is a slightly brighter red #E7230D. Social-proof badge '50+ Purchased Recently' is blue #006CE1 text on light blue #D3E7FC pill. Page section band / promo strip background is light grey #F2F4F7. Icons are Material Icons. Wordmark is bold black 'GameStop' with the red accent under the 'G' in the logo image.
branding.header_layout: Row 1 (white): hamburger 'Menu' icon | 'GameStop' wordmark (link to /) | wide rounded search box with magnifier icon, placeholder 'Search games, consoles & more' | right cluster of three icon+label links: 'Trade-In' (arrows icon, /trade/), 'Sign In' (person icon, /login/), 'Cart' (cart icon with red count badge, /cart/). Row 2 (white): horizontally scrolling category nav with chevrons. Row 3: light-grey promo strip 'Pre-Order The Newest Trading Cards Before They Sell Out.' linking to /pre-order-online-pick-up-in-store. Help pages additionally show 'GameStop Pro', 'Track Order' and a default nearby store name ('Ross Henderson S/C - GAMESTOP') in the header.

entry.search_results_layout: Heading 'Search Results for "grand theft auto vi"' with '(4 items)' beneath, 'Sort: Best Matches' dropdown at right. Left facet sidebar: Delivery Method (Ship to Home / Same Day Delivery / Pick Up as icon toggles), Categories (with counts), Platform, Condition, Franchise, Genre, New Releases (Dropping In The Next 3/6/12 Months), More Ways To Shop (Shop Pre-Orders), Customer Rating, Color, Brand, Edition, ESRB. Result grid of 3 tiles per row: cover art image, title (2-line clamp, link), price in bold, optional '$X for Pros' line in smaller text, 'Release Date MM/DD/YYYY' line for pre-orders, star rating + count for released items. Platform facet used the label 'Xbox Series X' (not X|S). Facet URL pattern: /search/?prefn1=platform&prefv1=PlayStation%205&q={q}
entry.category_path: Home > Video Games > PlayStation 5 (breadcrumb on PDP); Xbox variant is Home > Video Games > Xbox Series X|S. Top nav 'Pre-Order' links to /pre-order-online-pick-up-in-store.

checkout.url: https://www.gamestop.com/checkout/login/?required=false (302 to https://identity.gamestop.com/oidc/auth?scope=api:read offline_access openid address email phone profile&response_type=code&client_id=gamestop&redirect_uri=https://sfcc-ocapi.gamestop.com/shopper/auth/v1/idp/callback/default-gamestop&checkout=true&loginRequired=false; the OIDC provider then serves its sign-in UI at identity.gamestop.com/interaction/{uid} with /interaction/{uid}/create-account for registration, and returns to www.gamestop.com/checkout/)

auth.screen_text: NOT OBSERVED (twice): identity.gamestop.com shows a Cloudflare managed challenge ('Just a moment...' / 'Performing security verification / This website uses a security service to protect against malicious bots.'); every Wayback capture of identity.gamestop.com/interaction/{uid} is a 403 too. Help center: 'You can check out as a guest, but creating an account makes it easier to track, manage, and return orders.' GameStop's own main.js (July 2026) wires analytics to a sign-in page with: '.login-guest-checkout .checkout-as-guest' (analytics label 'Guest Checkout'), '.create-account-initial .create-account-button' ('Create Account'), '.forgot-password-link-js', and a 'keep me signed in' checkbox ('login:keepMeSignedIn'). Expected screen (low confidence on wording): GameStop-branded card with Email + Password + 'Keep me signed in' + 'Sign In', a 'Forgot password?' link, a 'Create Account' button, and a guest button in its own block.

steps.name: Checkout page - Shipping section
options: Shipping methods are radio buttons (input name ends in '_shippingMethodID') inside a '.shipping-method-set' with a '.display-name' and price; method names seen on confirmations: 'Premium $0.00', 'Rush $x.xx'; cart shows 'FREE Shipping on Pre-Orders $59+' for this item
Standard Shipping $6.99 (1-3 business days), FREE on pre-orders $59+ / orders $79+ / Pro orders $54+
Same Day Delivery $12.99 (only when a nearby store has stock; not offered for this pre-order)
Pick Up In Store (not available for this item)
steps.notes: Checkout is a SINGLE PAGE in the current build: main.js has a '.single-page-checkout' mode and the help center (updated 5/20/2026) says 'On the final checkout screen, you can: Confirm your shipping address, Apply gift cards or trade-in credit, Enter your payment method, Select Place Order' (medium confidence). No separate continue button in that mode. Legacy 3-stage SFRA flow still exists in main.js ('#checkout-main[data-checkout-stage]' = shipping / payment / placeOrder, URLs /checkout/?stage=shipping#shipping and /checkout/?stage=payment#payment, button '.submit-shipping' whose SFRA default label is 'Next: Payment'). Field LABELS are SFRA defaults and not observed (low confidence); the form is 'form.shipping-form' (class 'guest-checkout' for guests). Phone IS collected (printed under Shipping Address on confirmations); whether it is required is unverified. Email is not on this section (see Payment). An address-suggestion modal ('suggested address') exists. Help center: ships only within the continental U.S.; no freight forwarders/hotels/business addresses.

steps.name: Checkout page - Payment section and Place Order
options: Payment methods are Bootstrap tabs ('.payment-options a.nav-link[data-bs-toggle=tab]'): credit/debit card tab (label not verified, payment method id CREDIT_CARD), 'PayPal', 'BUY NOW, PAY LATER' (Zip per help center; a legacy '#klarna-checkout-btn' also remains in main.js)
GameStop Pro Credit Card (Comenity) is entered as a card in the card tab (main.js has 'purCC:avsError' handling)
Gift cards: separate apply block (#giftCertificateAmount, payment id GIFT_CERTIFICATE, analytics 'Payment|Gift Card Applied'); up to 2 per order
Trade-in credit: applied here per help center (no client-side trace found)
Accepted cards: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover (one card per order); PayPal incl. Pay in 4; Zip 4 or 8 payments
steps.notes: Field NAMES verified from main.js (July 2026 build): dwfrm_billing_paymentMethod, dwfrm_billing_creditCardFields_cardNumber (#cardNumber, Cleave.js formatting with brand detection visa/mastercard/discover/amex/unionPay/jcb/diners), dwfrm_billing_creditCardFields_expirationMonthYear (#expirationMonthYear, ONE combined month/year field, not two selects), dwfrm_billing_creditCardFields_securityCode (#securityCode, maxlength 3, or 4 for Amex). There is NO cardOwner / 'Name on Card' field; the confirmation page shows the billing-address name as card holder. Cards are tokenised with CyberSource Secure Acceptance Flex ('SA_FLEX'). Visible labels ('Security Code' vs 'CVV', MM/YY placeholder, card-tab label) not observed (low confidence). 'Place Order' is the help-center name of the final control; a payment summary with an Edit link ('.updatePaymentLink', analytics 'Edit Payment') exists. In legacy stage mode the payment button was '.submit-payment' (SFRA default 'Next: Place Order') followed by a placeOrder stage.

payment_methods: GameStop Gift Card (physical or digital, up to 2 per order)
Apple Pay (cart express slot only, Safari on Apple devices; SFCC applepay.js is loaded but the help center does not list it)

No charge-timing sentence was found in the checkout client JS or on three archived confirmation pages; whether the checkout page itself shows one is unverified.

quirks: Physical SKU is 'Code in Box': the box contains only a download code, no disc; PS5 code only works on US/Canada PlayStation accounts.
Listed 'Release Date: 11/12/2026' is the code-in-box/pre-load ship date, one week before the Nov 19 launch; delivery text says 'Arrives on or shortly after release day'.
Only Standard edition is sold (Edition facet: Standard (2)); no Ultimate, disc or digital GTA VI SKU on GameStop.com today.
'Pick up in-store' shows 'Not Available' for this item; Ship to Home is the only fulfillment option.
Pre-orders get free shipping at $59+ (regular orders $79+, Pro $54+).
Coupons/promo codes cannot be applied to pre-orders even though the cart shows an 'ENTER PROMO CODE' field.
Card is only authorized at checkout; pre-orders are charged about a week before release. Split pay online only via PayPal Pay in 4 (or Zip at cart).
Guest pre-orders can only be cancelled by emailing care@gamestop.com; signed-in orders can self-cancel from Order History until processing starts.
Checkout hands off to identity.gamestop.com (OIDC) which sits behind a Cloudflare bot check; automated browsers are stopped there.
Cookie banner at the bottom with 'Accept', 'Opt-Out', 'More Info' — it does not block interaction.
Cart shows an estimated tax ($5.70 on $79.99) before any address is entered, based on a geo-default store/location.
Header shows a default 'my store' (e.g. 'Ross Henderson S/C - GAMESTOP') on some pages; product page has 'Change Store' / 'Verify Address' hidden controls.
Quantity is not chosen on the PDP; the cart has a Qty 1-5 dropdown.
Xbox listing is titled 'Xbox Series X/S' but the Platform selector/facet label is 'Xbox Series X'.
Persistent Pro upsells: PDP credit-card banner, PDP 'Join Pro Now', cart 'Don't Miss Out' block; other tiles show '$X for Pros' pricing.

The guest basket persisted between browser sessions and adding the same SKU again created a SECOND line item (Qty 1 each) instead of incrementing quantity: cart read 'Ship To Home: 2 Items', 'Subtotal (2 items) $159.98', 'Estimated Tax $11.40', 'Estimated Total $171.38'.

Checkout is a Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFRA) storefront; the July-2026 main.js carries both a single-page checkout and the legacy 3-stage flow (/checkout/?stage=shipping, ?stage=payment, placeOrder).
Card expiry is one combined MM/YY field and there is no Name on Card field; cards go through CyberSource Flex.
Payment methods at checkout are tabs, one of them literally titled 'BUY NOW, PAY LATER' (Zip).
Order numbers moved from the 1100000... range (2025) to 1101000... (2026).
Cart express slot holds a PayPal iframe (logo only, no text) and a Safari-only Apple Pay slot; in Chromium the area above 'OR' looks empty.

gaps: identity.gamestop.com sign-in/guest screen still not observed. Second attempt (2026-09-29) hit the Cloudflare managed challenge again ('Just a moment...'); not retried per rules. Wayback has captures of identity.gamestop.com/interaction/{uid} and /interaction/{uid}/create-account but all are 403, and www.gamestop.com/login/ captures since Feb 2025 are redirect stubs into identity. Headline, the exact guest button text ('Checkout as Guest' vs 'Continue as Guest') and whether the guest path asks for an email before the shipping form remain unverified; current best guess comes from the CSS class 'checkout-as-guest' and analytics label 'Guest Checkout' in main.js.

Visible checkout labels are not observed: shipping-address field labels (SFRA defaults assumed), whether Phone Number is required (it is collected), the card tab's title, 'Security Code' vs 'CVV', and the MM/YY placeholder. Field NAMES, the single combined expiry field, the absence of a Name on Card field and the tab layout are verified from GameStop's archived main.js.

Single-page vs 3-stage: main.js contains both. The help center's 'final checkout screen' wording points to single-page as the live default (medium confidence), but this was not seen; if the legacy stage flow is served, the buttons are SFRA's 'Next: Payment' / 'Next: Place Order' (labels not verified). Exact position of 'Place Order' (order-summary column vs bottom of the payment section) is unverified.

Whether the checkout page shows any pre-order charge-timing sentence (e.g. 'You will not be charged until...') is unverifiable from client JS or confirmation captures; only the PDP line 'Billing does not occur until order is processed' and the help-center wording are confirmed.
Account sign-up field list is from general knowledge (low confidence); only the /interaction/{uid}/create-account route is confirmed.
The Product Description and Specs accordions on the PDP were collapsed and the description panel contained only the Pro benefits block; no long-form description text was available.

WebFetch returns HTTP 403 for gamestop.com and identity.gamestop.com and cannot reach web.archive.org/archive.org; the WebSearch budget was exhausted before this follow-up (0 searches possible), so third-party guides could not be located. Wayback CDX queries for www.gamestop.com/checkout* returned 'Temporarily Offline'; no archived checkout-stage page was found.
No YouTube walkthrough transcript of a GameStop checkout was found.
